# CarAdvance

> CarAdvance is a premium car company with German roots (Caradvance GmbH, since 2003), represented in Hungary by BH Group Zrt. We offer long-term rental (tartós bérlet) of brand-new premium cars from 6 months, used premium cars for sale from Germany, new car orders at German prices, and car import from Germany. Prices are shown net (excl. VAT); rental includes servicing, tax, insurance and tyres.

Contact (Hungary): +36 30 233 6060 · info@caradvance.hu · https://www.caradvance.hu/kapcsolat/
Other markets: https://www.caradvance.sk (Slovakia), https://www.caradvance.cz (Czechia)

## Long-term rental (tartós bérlet)

- [Rental cars available now – prices, km options, availability](https://www.caradvance.hu/autoink/#berelheto): BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, MINI, Volkswagen, CUPRA, Hyundai, Kia and more; monthly fee for 2 000 km/month, 3 000 km +250 €, 4 000 km +500 € (net); minimum term 6 months; refundable deposit.
- [Tartós bérlet – how it works](https://www.caradvance.hu/tartos-berlet/)
